messages:
Mira: quick question — we want premium tenants routed to the closest healthy region but still allow model-variant fallback (quantized / cheaper) if the primary region is saturated. can we express this without exploding policy rules?
Alex: we do something similar today with simple region affinity + penalty score. what's new here is the model-variant fallback requirement, right?
Mira: yep. goal: if eu-west-1 latency <= 80ms serve full-precision model. if overloaded, fall back to eu-central variant. if no capacity but latency for remote region < 250ms, allow remote with quantized variant as last resort. premium should never route to spot-tier unless explicit opt-in.
PJ: agree. also need KV cache affinity — if we route to remote, warmup cost is huge. maybe prefer variants that share identical kv-layout to avoid misses.
David: cost note: remote + quantized still costs more egress and SLO risk. need quota gating so premium customers don't silently rack up remote egress.
Sam: dashboard ask: show per-tenant breakdown of region hits, fallback count, avg latency, and egress bytes for last 24h. want a single rollup widget for account health.
Mira: here's an early policy sketch, let me know if readable:
```yaml
routingPolicy:
  tiers:
    premium:
      prefer_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
      latency_slo_ms: 100
      max_remote_latency_ms: 250
      allow_remote: true
      variants_priority:
        - model:palm-13b-fp32
        - model:palm-13b-INT8
        - model:palm-13b-q4_0
      fallback_rules:
        - when: region_overload
          to: eu-central-1
          variant: palm-13b-INT8
        - when: capacity_exhausted && remote_latency < 250
          to: any-region
          variant: palm-13b-q4_0
      forbid_spot_unless: explicit_opt_in
```
Alex: looks good, one tweak: add weight and penalty fields so we can tune hysteresis without hard switches. e.g. penalty: 30 (seconds) to avoid oscillation.
PJ: and add kv_affinity: true + gemini-compat flag (or an equivalent) so runtime can prefer variants with identical cache layout.
Mira: good call. also question for infra-bot: can we get a probe that reports p95 probe latency + health score per region per model variant? ops-bot previously exposed only node-level probe.
infra-bot: new probe endpoint available on /internal/region_probe. returns p50/p95/p99 and capacity_estimate per region+variant. will enable canary next-week.
David: for quotas i propose a soft-quota for remote-fallback bytes: per-tenant rolling 24h. if exceeded, throttle remote-fallback and route to degrade mode (shorter max_tokens) instead.
Sam: UX: in rollouts console show a compact timeline: primary region -> fallback counts -> recent throttles with reason (quota, latency, overload). link to tenant-level toggles (allow_remote_fallback: true/false).
Mira: what about testing? can we simulate a saturated eu-west and verify route->eu-central then to remote-quantized? any test harness?
Alex: we have a seq test harness: run loader against eu-west control plane, set capacity_estimate=0 via the probe mock, then assert routing decisions. sample script:
```bash
# simulate overload
curl -X POST https://staging-internal/redwood-test/sim_probe -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","capacity_estimate":0}'
# issue request as premium tenant
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer premium-test-key" -d '{"input":"hello","model":"palm-13b"}' https://api.staging.redwood/v1/generate | jq .routing_decision
```
PJ: make sure to include kv-warmup latency in the assertion. i can add a synthetic that reports cache_miss_penalty_ms so we can validate end-to-end.
Mira: ok next steps: Alex will add penalty/weight knobs, PJ adds kv_affinity flag, infra-bot will enable the probe for variants, David will draft quota throttle action, Sam will spec dashboard tiles. I'll draft a short RFC for eng-platform->prod rollout plan.
Alex: 👍 will send a PR for the policy schema and a migration plan.
PJ: i'll prototype the kv-affinity change in runtime branch.
David: i'll sketch the quota thresholds and mitigation messages for support.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for staging at 18:30 UTC today. watch for increased fallback_count metric.
Mira: super, thanks everyone. will ping when RFC is up. :metal:
